programme.title: Rise: Sustainable Home Tours

programme.title: Rise: Sustainable Home Tours

programme.title: Rise: Sustainable Home Tours
programme.desc: Michael and Michelle were very involved with the design of their Passive House. They wanted a house that was beautiful, but also very energy efficient. Their beautiful bungalow uses less energy than it makes (net positive).

programme.title: Rise: Sustainable Home Tours
programme.desc: Welcome to the Passive House Ranch! Homeowners Beate and Bern have created a state of the art modern home while preserving the structure's original character. Their passive house has a classic ranch design with high-performance features that bring next-level comfort.

programme.title: Rise: Sustainable Home Tours
programme.desc: Are you still using natural gas in your home? Have you thought about the health impacts of doing so? Bruce Nilles--a Senior Fellow at the Rocky Mountain Institute--realized that his biggest carbon footprint was his own home.

programme.title: Rise: Sustainable Home Tours
programme.desc: Welcome to one of the most sustainable celebrity homes in Los Angeles. In this video, we take you on a house tour of Ed Begley Jr.’s LEED Platinum home and get an up-close look at some pretty impressive sustainable features.

programme.title: Rise: Sustainable Home Tours
programme.desc: A lot of people think that a sustainable home means living in a mud hut, but as you’ll see in this video, that’s not at all the case. As long as you make good building and design decisions, you can have a beautiful, fun, creative home that is also sustainable.

programme.title: Rise: Sustainable Home Tours
programme.desc: These homeowners took the mystery out of sustainable home improvement and completely removed gas from their home. Take a tour of their completed electrification project.

programme.title: Rise: Sustainable Home Tours

programme.title: Rise: Sustainable Home Tours

programme.desc: This lab in New York City is saving the rainforest! C16 Biosciences have created a truly sustainable alternative to Palm Oil using yeast!
